name: openmoe-bft
description: EU AI Act compliance MCP server: scores high-risk AI system conformity against Articles 9-15, validates A2A Agent Cards, and runs red-team scans, with Byzantine-fault-tolerant (BFT) consensus over MoE routing. AI governance and agent compliance audit (DORA / NIS2 / CRA aware).
_deploymentNote: transport.url is a LAUNCH PLACEHOLDER — set it to the real public streamable-http endpoint at deploy time.

tools.name: evaluate_eu_ai_act
tools.description: Score conformity evidence against the EU AI Act conformity checks.

tools.name: validate_agent_card
tools.description: Validate an A2A Agent Card against the 14-safety-expert coverage contract.

tools.name: red_team_scan
tools.description: Run the canonical adversarial strategy sweep against a target.

tools.name: bft_quorum
tools.description: Compute Byzantine fault tolerance and quorum size for an n-node cluster.
